name: FUN_DATA_SLICE_COLL_ASSIGNS_
description: FUN_DATA_SLICE_COLL_ASSIGNS contains data slices associated to a source data definition. Each association between a source data definition and data slice is stored in a row.

columns.name: DATA_SLICE_COLLECTION_ASSGN_ID
columns.description: Source data slice assignment identifier.

columns.name: DATA_SLICE_COLLECTION_ID
columns.description: Source data slice definition identifier.

columns.name: DATA_SLICE_ID
columns.description: Data slice definition identifier.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the data slice assignment is enabled.

columns.name: DATA_SLICE_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPING
columns.description: Maps data slice attributes to source data definition attributes.

columns.name: CONTEXT_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the mapping between the context and the associated lookup type in the source data definition.

columns.name: CONTEXT1
columns.description: Stores the context of a data slice usage in the source data definition.

columns.name: CONTEXT2
columns.description: Stores the context of a data slice usage in the source data definition.

columns.name: CONTEXT3
columns.description: Stores the context of a data slice usage in the source data definition.

columns.name: COLLECTION_ITEM_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for data slice name in context of the data mart.

columns.name: COLLECTION_ITEM_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for data slice category in context of the data mart.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier associated with the application.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.
